summary.text: Lat-Nam is an island of Dominaria, once the seat of the College of Lat-Nam, which Drafna and Hurkyl founded to codify magic.

bio.text: Drafna and Hurkyl founded the college to codify magic, understand Thran artifacts and stop the brothers, and the sages created the Stone Brain, which was launched into space instead of being destroyed.
The brothers laid waste to the college, leaving a poisoned glass desert for 4000 years.
Survivors founded the Institute of Arcane Study and the School of the Unseen, which later relocated and was destroyed.
In 4077 AR Greensleeves came to Lat-Nam to uncover the Stone Brain's secrets, battling and befriending its guardians.
She poured all her mana into the land, turning it into a paradise at the cost of her planeswalker powers, and became High Wizard of the Domains.
In 4562 AR Geyadrone Dihada disposed of the Tolarian Academy's archmage, and Ertai and the Society of Mishra later turned it into a haven for dark research.

status.text: The latest events show the Tolarian Academy at Lat-Nam taken over by Geyadrone Dihada and then used by the Society of Mishra for dark research.
